title: Harbor Energy Services Form 8-K covenant default
bodyText:
UNITED STATES
FORM 8-K
Item 2.04 Triggering Events That Accelerate or Increase a Direct Financial Obligation.
On May 10, 2026, Harbor Energy Services received notice from its lenders that an event of default occurred under its credit agreement because the Company failed to satisfy a minimum liquidity covenant. The lenders reserved their rights and remedies. The Company is seeking a waiver and evaluating restructuring alternatives.
Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits.
